comment.title: Use .map()/.join() instead of a manual for-loop with string concatenation
comment.body: The team guideline prefers declarative array transforms over index-based loops that build strings by concatenation.
comment.takeaway: Reach for .map()/.filter()/.join() before writing an index-based loop.

humanReply: You're wrong here — this loop is in a hot path that formats exports with up to 500k rows, and we deliberately avoid building intermediate arrays. Perf-sensitive loops are exempt from the declarative-transforms preference.
